messages:
alex: Hey @maya @jon — quick heads-up: SDK PR #412 is green but blocked on the API bump in api-server. Can we coordinate a merge window today? This touches SDK + console + helm charts and needs a short canary.

maya: What's blocking the API PR specifically? CI or design?

jon: CI was the main blocker earlier — integration test failed because console still hits the old endpoint shape. I left a comment for a small fallback in console to handle both payload shapes. :eyes: Link: https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/328

alex: Links: sdk PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/412  |  api PR: https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/328  |  console PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/214  |  helm chart bump: https://github.com/redwood/charts/pull/87

luis: I'm out for lunch until 12:30 PT but can approve after that. Please add a release note and set a compatibility flag in the SDK so Dedicated customers don't get surprised. :+1:

ci-bot: CI: sdk#412 integration ✅, api#328 flaky test: call_timeout_test failed on node12; please /retest

maya: /retest done on api#328 — integration passed this run.

alex: Proposed merge order (to minimize rollout risk): api -> sdk -> console -> helm. Rationale: API change surfaces header X-Request-Mode which SDK can use to enable new codepath; console can opt-in after sdk ships. Requesting a 30m canary in staging, then prod. Can we target 15:30 UTC for the window?

jon: 15:30 UTC works for me. I'll provision a canary namespace and a minimal console deployment. Command I'll run:

```
helm upgrade --install canary-console ./charts/console --set replicas=1 --namespace canary
```

jon: Also I'll attach a circuit-breaker and lower traffic weight.

maya: Minor concern: runtime kernel selection depends on default max_seq; SDK change bumps default max_seq and could affect latency on older GPUs. We should pin model variant for Dedicated or add a runtime guard. Suggest SDK fallback: if X-Request-Mode missing treat request as legacy.

alex: Agreed. I'll add the fallback in SDK now. Patch snippet:

```
// treat requests without header as legacy mode
if (req.headers['x-request-mode'] === undefined) {
  req.mode = 'legacy'
}
```

alex: I'll also add a release-note entry and compatibility flag in the SDK release notes.

jon: After merges, I'll run full e2e against canary: `./scripts/e2e.sh --namespace canary` and smoke tests for latency.

sre-bot: Reminder: merging outside scheduled merge windows requires approval from platform-ops. Current merge window today: 15:30-16:30 UTC. Please coordinate and add a post-merge rollout plan. :bell:

luis: I can approve SDK once API is merged. @alex ping me here after you merge API.

alex: Plan: I'll merge API at ~15:28 UTC, tag v1.4.2, then merge SDK -> console -> charts with staggered holds. Pinging here when API is merged.

alex: API merged and tagged v1.4.2. Kicking off SDK merge now. Will update with canary status.
